description: This file implements a configuration file storage system for Mattermost, including methods for creating, resolving paths, loading, saving, and managing configuration files and the main configuration object.

classes.name: FileStore
classes.description: A struct representing a file-based configuration store with methods for managing configuration files and the main configuration.

methods.name: NewFileStore
methods.description: Creates a new FileStore instance, resolving the path and optionally creating the file if it does not exist.

methods.name: resolveConfigFilePath
methods.description: Resolves a given configuration file path to an absolute path, searching in common directories if necessary.

methods.name: resolveFilePath
methods.description: Resolves a filename to an absolute path based on the store's main file path.

methods.name: Set
methods.description: Replaces the current configuration with a new one, respecting read-only settings.

methods.name: persist
methods.description: Serializes and writes the configuration to the file system.

methods.name: Load
methods.description: Loads the configuration data from the file system.

methods.name: GetFile
methods.description: Retrieves the contents of a persisted configuration file.

methods.name: GetFilePath
methods.description: Returns the resolved path of a configuration file.

methods.name: SetFile
methods.description: Writes data to a specified configuration file.

methods.name: HasFile
methods.description: Checks if a configuration file exists.

methods.name: RemoveFile
methods.description: Removes a persisted configuration file, skipping absolute paths.

methods.name: String
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the store's file path.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Performs cleanup of resources, if necessary.
